ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course section is open only to admitted NRES MS online degree-seeking students This section is a self-paced orientation course to the NRES MS program. The instructor will contact enrolled students via email or phone and provide them with course access instructions. This is not a joint offering with any other program.
